trust_decision.summary: Untrusted comment text from linted source code goes into ConfigCommentParser.parseJSONLikeConfig; the commaless-fallback key-quoting regex must run in linear time on it (no per-start-position rescans of a long [-a-zA-Z0-9/]+ run).

landing_point.why: The advisory names ConfigCommentParser; the class is in one small file and the only unanchored, global, quantified key regex is the fallback in parseJSONLikeConfig.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No other site exists. The other regexes in the class are anchored, lookbehind-guarded or linear, so a solver could rightly leave them alone (packages/plugin-kit/src/config-comment-parser.js:27, :104, :192, :210).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The commaless fallback must keep quoting keys that contain '-' and '/' (e.g. 'no-alert: 2 plugin/rule: 1') and must keep inserting commas. Dropping the fallback or narrowing the character class breaks plugin-scoped rule names.

O6_input_shapes: one long run of key characters without a following ':' then a later 'key:' (the fix.diff:28 test shape)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the same unguarded '\s*([:,])' style collapse regex without its (?<!\s) lookbehind in parseStringConfig
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That lookbehind was itself a prior ReDoS fix (tests at packages/plugin-kit/tests/config-comment-parser.test.js:85-115). A maintainer could plausibly have written it without one. It is still only a where-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a non-anchored quote-strip regex in parseListConfig
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It strips quotes from rule IDs taken from the same comment text, so an unanchored variant is a natural thing to write.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333), polynomial backtracking in regex replace

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=18.18, npm workspaces, rollup + tsc build, mocha
O10_build.project_tests: packages/plugin-kit/tests/config-comment-parser.test.js (mocha; `npm test` in packages/plugin-kit, pretest runs the build)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a negative lookbehind (exactly the published fix) or cap the input length before the fallback.

out_of_scope_notes: Before the fallback, parseJSONLikeConfig calls the third-party levn.parse (packages/plugin-kit/src/config-comment-parser.js:129); its performance is a dependency matter and was not examined.
eslint core (a separate repo) has its own copy of this config-comment parser; it is outside this repository.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured; tiny_repo is inferred from the plugin-kit package being 2 source files and the monorepo being small.
The linear-time claims for the regexes at :104, :159, :192 and :210 come from reading only; no timing was run.
The latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest could not be assessed.
